evals.prompt: I need to configure my Trigger.dev project to use Prisma for database access and FFmpeg for video processing. Show me the complete trigger.config.ts.
evals.expected_output: Should show defineConfig with the required maxDuration, prismaExtension with an explicit mode, and ffmpeg from the core extensions entry, both in build.extensions
expectations: Passes an explicit mode to prismaExtension (legacy, engine-only or modern)
Sets the required maxDuration (seconds, at least 5) in defineConfig
